refactor(fault-proofs): split native script decoding step 03
wip: double-spend vertical slice reference-script conversion

feat(fault-proofs): register value-not-preserved, input-set-uniqueness, and mint-authorization catalogue families

Append the three families to the canonical catalogue at their reserved
ids 00000019/0000001a/0000001b (ORDER 25 -> 28), now that each meets the
registration bar (onchain + offchain + both-polarity T1/T2 emulator
coverage). The emulator harness flips from bespoke pre-registration
records to SDK canonical builders, removal legs resolve by canonical
category name (explicit-category helpers deleted; the fail-closed id
collision guard now rejects them by design), and the node deployment
manifest gains the 11 step contracts (canonical manifestId re-pinned).
Q13 catalogue root re-pinned for the 28-entry fold. Matrices and ledger
updated; initialization-emulator's pre-existing nsd step-03 oversized
publication red recorded, not fixed.

fix(fault-proofs): resolve carriage chunk indices against the complete reference-input set

The native-script-decoding step-03 bind arms built their §8.8 field openings
from the carriage UTxOs alone, while the submitted transaction also
references the step's reference-script UTxO. The opening's positional
ref_input_index values resolve against the transaction's canonically sorted
complete reference-input set, so whenever the publication outref sorted
after the step reference the recorded index named the wrong UTxO and the
door crashed — a per-run coin flip on emulator transaction hashes that the
new size-selected tier-2 bind surfaced.

Resolve the step reference before constructing the opening in both the
BindOutpoint and BindOutOfDomain arms and pass the complete set, and thread
the same set through the raw test builder's opening.

feat(fault-proofs): mint-authorization emulator lifecycle with size-driven carriage tiers

Complete the mint-authorization family to the registration bar: an emulator
support module (subject builder over canonical field-1/5/6/7 preimages,
harness wiring under the reserved test category 0000001b, five-step
reference-script publisher, removal-category record, size-growing fixtures,
and a raw tampered-carriage builder), plus both-polarity suites — direction-A
witness-absence and direction-B unsatisfied-script lifecycles through the
removal leg, four adversarial refusals (rejected leaf, false absence, false
unsatisfied, tampered tier-2 publication refused at the on-chain
field-commitment re-hash), and size-forced RawUtxo journeys for the field-5
mint and field-7 address-witness doors where the preimage alone crosses the
tier-1 bound.

Step-02/03/04 submitters ride the generic §8 carriage pipeline with no
publish or override knobs; the tier is decided solely by preimage byte
length. A prover-only cancel submitter completes the family surface.

test(fault-proofs): value-not-preserved both-polarity emulator suites with size-driven carriage tiers

Complete the value-not-preserved family to the registration bar:

- step-03 submitter gains genuine tier-2 plumbing: openings planned via
  planFaultProofFieldOpeningV1, over-cap preimages published through
  publishFaultProofFieldCarriageV1 (content-addressed reuse), one shared
  reference-input array feeding every faultProofFieldCarriageV1 call and
  the single readFrom; tiers are selected purely by preimage size, no
  override exists. Fee/preset wallet candidates exclude datum-bearing
  UTxOs so a fresh publication can never be spent as fees. A doc-commented
  test-only unsafeSpendFieldRawUtxoForTest option names an injected
  publication positionally (tampered-preimage refusal scenarios only).
- shared support module: canonical outputs/mint fixtures with genuine
  pre-state ledger MPF descriptors; the scenario setup commits an anchor
  block carrying the ledger root as utxos_root and the fraudulent block
  as its successor, because the state-queue commit chains prev_utxos_root
  exactly; raw bind/finalize builders reach the validators own refusals.
- four suites: tier-1 token lifecycle + removal leg; size-forced tier-2
  ADA lifecycle (14,800-byte outputs preimage in the (14,336, 15,148]
  RawUtxo window) + removal leg; adversarial balanced-fold and
  tampered-tier-2-publication refusals with honest conviction on the same
  thread; rejected-leaf and forged-step-02-witness negatives.

test(fault-proofs): size-selected tier-2 bind for native-script-decoding

Let the decoding scenario commit fabricated decoy outpoints beside
the accused one, sorted canonically with the accused's post-sort
ordinal reported, so a subject field can grow past §8.4's tier-1
bound. The new journey buries the accused outpoint among 364 decoys
(a 14,603-byte subject-field preimage), the finding names the sorted
ordinal, the bind's opening routes to RawUtxo on size alone through
step-03's existing ladder plumbing, and the direction-A conviction
still lands through the published preimage.

test(fault-proofs): size-selected tier-2 outputs journey for input-no-idx

Wire the §8 carriage ladder into step-04's outputs opening — publish
when the plan says so, reference the publication, and never spend a
UTxO the transaction must read — and expose the tier the ladder
picked. The fixture now commits every producing output (it previously
dropped all but the first, which no caller past one output had
noticed) and wraps the payment byte so large output counts stay
canonical. The new journey commits a 340-output producer (14,623-byte
field-2 preimage): step-02's one-item field stays Inline while
step-04's oversized field routes to RawUtxo, both decided by size
alone, and the conviction lands through the published preimage.
